authorityEvidence: The maintainer explicitly directs completion of NF-102-03 through NF-102-06, separate commits/pushes/PRs and sequential merges, and delegates all technical decisions. He expressly confirms project signing certificates/accounts are unavailable and requests a certificate-free way forward. This separate decision exercises that authority on the exact committed RFC and technical review; it does not infer acceptance from CI, publication or merge, or claim a separately received personal review/signature.
rationale: Adopt TypeScript and layout B on qualified source-bound evidence and the unchanged original weights: 55.8 versus Python 52.8. Python cold-start, native-memory and all build/CI advantages remain explicit. TypeScript wins the nine library-throughput pairs and has the limited type/API-maintenance judgment; no ranking override or failed-gate compensation occurs. Its actual identical source/declaration distributions support external-Node JavaScript delivery without shipping a project native executable. No unperformed project signing or public trust is called passed.
